thread:
Maya: FYI incoming from Sparrowhawk — they dropped a hybrid package (LoRA + small full-finetune) for the customer billing flow. quick-eval shows weird amount formatting changes.
Tony: Can you drop the eval artifacts? sample prompts + golden outputs + our baseline outputs.
Maya: Link: https://artifacts.redwood/sparrowhawk/hybrid-eval/4198765432 (read-only)
Maya: Quick summary: BLEU-ish not great for this task, but more concerning is tokenizer alignment. Example: input 'Total: $1,200' -> model outputs 'Total: USD 1200.00' (ours used '$1,200').
Eva: Huh. That smells like tokenizer detokenization differences or a locale-aware postproc introduced by the finetune. Do we have tokenizer version pinned in the LoRA repo?
Maya: Repo shows tokenizer v2.1. Our infra uses v2.0 baseline. LoRA metadata: "tokenizer_hash": "a3f7c9".
Sam: Could be normalization added in the training data. Quick test: run `python -m redwood.eval.cli --model sparrowhawk-hybrid:latest --prompts examples/amounts.jsonl --quant int4` to reproduce on our quant path.
Tony: Started a rapid run on the GPU pool, job id 98765. ci-bot: Build queued, will run on pool-quant-4.
ci-bot: Job 98765 started on pool-quant-4 (approx ETA 8m)
Eva: I ran a small local repro on int4 and saw tokens differ at punctuation: token ids around the comma collapsed in quantized path -> affects detokenizer heuristics. Paste of sample diff:
```
prompt: "Total: $1,200"
baseline gen: "Total: $1,200"
hybrid int4 gen: "Total: USD 1200.00"
log snippet: detok_rule_apply(locale=True) -> True
```
Sam: If detok rules are a postprocess flag, we might be able to toggle it off for Sparrowhawk. But need to confirm this isn't required by their training data.
Maya: Action items: 1) Tony to attach a minimized eval pack with 50 amount examples; 2) Eva to run tokenizer-diff between v2.0 and v2.1; 3) Sam to run a quantized vs fp16 comparison and check whether it's quantization-only or model-level.
Tony: I'll push a pared-down eval pack to the artifacts link under `/mini-pack-50.jsonl` in ~20m.
Eva: Preliminary tokenizer diff: v2.1 introduced a `locale_merge` rule for currency tokens — likely culprit. Suggest we try serving hybrid without applying `locale_merge` to see behavior.
Sam: I'll run the fp16 vs int4 sweep and post result snippets here. If it's only the int4 path, plan: recommend int8 for Sparrowhawk Dedicated until we fix quant kernels or remove the postproc flag.
Maya: Good plan. Also cc'ing @infra-sre for potential dedicated capacity note if we need to pin int8.
ci-bot: Job 98765 completed. Results uploaded to artifacts (latency 7.9s, 50 samples). See `results/98765-summary.json`.
Tony: Uploaded mini-pack and annotated diffs at the artifact link. quick stats: 50 examples: baseline exact-match 48/50, hybrid fp16 47/50, hybrid int4 41/50.
Eva: That delta (fp16 -> int4) confirms quantization amplifies the tokenizer/postproc mismatch. I'll try toggling `locale_merge` off in a patched detok and rerun on int4.
Sam: If toggle fixes it, we can add a per-customer serving override in routing policy: serve hybrid with detok_override: false for Sparrowhawk on int4 pools.
Maya: Thanks all. Keep updates short here. We'll collect a recommendation doc after Eva/Sam results. :thumbsup:
